svg.title: The playbook gives the deeper discount to the thinner margin: after its offer At Risk keeps 37 points of order value, Hibernating 27
svg.desc: Dot-and-arrow chart for At Risk and Hibernating: each arrow runs from realised gross margin before the win-back discount (light dot) to contribution after it (dark dot), in percent of pre-offer order value. At Risk falls from 51.97% to 36.97% after a 15% discount; Hibernating falls from 46.69% to 26.69% after a 20% discount.
